headline: Sail Croatia® Official Site - Navigator Party Cruises - Don't miss out
primaryText: 7 Day Navigator Party Cruises and Croatia Island Hopping for 18-35's Exclusive Access to the Hottest Clubs & Festivals on Hvar, Zrce, Split, Dubrovnik and more. Fully Stocked… (cut off)
whyItWorks: It speaks directly to 18-35 year olds who want a party trip, so the right people feel it is made for them. Sitelinks like Traveling Solo? and Group Travel cover different buyer situations, and the review count builds trust right on the results page. The 10% cabin discount gives a small nudge to book, and it was still showing as of the last-shown date.
